observation: Fifty-five loose solids in the opening setup. Top: twenty-four lane tiles fan from the hub to one clean outer circle, tones alternating light and dark, with a constant thin orange margin between every pair and no notch or bay in any tile end; thirty teardrop counters sit two, five, three and five to a lane on the correct points, every one inside its own lane and clear of its neighbours. Iso: each tile is seated in its pocket and stands slightly proud, the centre bar is the highest part of the board, and the corona is forty-eight separate curled flames standing off an unbroken disc edge with open ground in every valley. No closed loop, arch, ribbon or handle anywhere. Front: one flat board 6.2 mm tall with counters resting on the tile tops; nothing floats, nothing interpenetrates, no part is missing, extra or misplaced.
